push.title: L 0-2 vs Two Man Elite | You: 6.6 (3rd worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.6. If you ever wonder whether I've got your back, the answer is always.

THE GOOD
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 33%). Win the ball, start the attack. You did both.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.
+ Team-high 1 shots on target. That's the good stuff, like the corner piece of the brownie.
+ Fewest giveaways on the team (7). You earned that one the honest way.
+ 1 key pass: +0.1. Steady contributions win seasons.

THE BAD
- Rating came in 0.8 below what your on-ball stats earned. Next rep: Hold your spot in the shape when the ball's on the far side. Drifting leaves the back line naked. Small fix, big smile.
- You and tuxedo_slide were in the same boat on forcing passes. Row together: give each other short options.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 2. We don't hide from that one; we fix it.
- Tackles attempted: 3. Good foundation, 6+ ceiling.

THE UGLY
! 70% passing (14 of 20, down from your usual 77%). Simple fix: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. Little by little.

Five minutes of this: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

Hey, BellyTb1. Quiet feet, loud heart.

Keep your chin up and your effort higher. - Coach Lasso
